I couldn't write any notes on Psalm 3 this time. My research tool was blocked before any page loaded, so I didn't read a single source.

I tried to load Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Augustine's commentary on Psalms on New Advent, Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub, and the NET Bible notes. Every attempt failed with a "no more tool calls remaining this turn" error, and a second try failed the same way. My other tool has no internet access, so it couldn't help.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and give a URL for every point. With nothing read, I can't do that, so I haven't written notes from memory, partial or otherwise.

If you send the request again in a new message, the tool limit should reset. I'll start with those same sources for the traditional reading and add Spurgeon, Wesley, Lutheran and Catholic/Orthodox pages for the differing views. If you'd rather, you can paste text from particular commentary pages and I'll write the verse-by-verse notes from that.
